# Research report 1 of 2

I couldn't find betting odds or a market price for this match from before the cutoff. My searches also turned up post-match reports and odds dated after 2026-08-31, and I've left all of them out, as the exercise requires.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding source is UEFA's official result, with Flashscore and then Sofascore as fallbacks. No URL is given.
- 2026-08-27 to 08-29: The match should be the first league-phase game of the 2026/27 UEFA Champions League (Matchday 1 runs 8-10 September). Sporting's home opponents from the draw are Barcelona, Manchester United, Galatasaray and LASK. [UEFA](https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/02a8-216cd740d41f-fd3b45ac4a0f-1000/), [Football360](https://football360.com.au/?p=50762), [Portugoal](https://portugoal.net/club-news/6017-champions-league-draw-sporting-and-porto-land-english-giants)
- Fixture listings point to Sporting vs Galatasaray at Estádio José Alvalade on Wednesday 9 September, kickoff 19:00 UTC (20:00 Lisbon). UEFA said it would publish the fixture list by 29 August. [Sporting calendar](https://www.sporting.pt/en/agenda/calendar), [FotMob](https://www.fotmob.com/hi/match/6106280)

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-08-31, the match hasn't been played and nothing settles the question. It resolves on the 90-minute result only, so a draw resolves "No".

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08 (date not confirmed): An undated aggregator lists Sporting 3-1 Alverca (Matchday 3) and Rio Ave 0-4 Sporting (Matchday 4). Neither result is verified, and Matchday 4 may fall after the cutoff. [LaPreferente](https://www.lapreferente.com/index.php?comp=26806)
- 2026-08-27: The draw gave Sporting a hard schedule. Away games are Manchester City, Roma, Shakhtar and Lens. [Football360](https://football360.com.au/?p=50762)
- 2026-08-21: Galatasaray won 4-0 away at Erzurumspor in the Süper Lig. Okan Buruk is still head coach. [Wikipedia, Galatasaray 2026-27](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E2%80%9327_Galatasaray_S.K._season)
- 2026-08-14: Sporting got their first league win, 3-2 at home to Vitória SC. They led early, the second half was harder, and Ioannidis scored. [Sporting.pt](https://www.sporting.pt/en/news/football/main-team/2026-08-14/first-win-sporting-cp)
- 2026-08-08: Sporting drew 2-2 away at Estrela da Amadora on Matchday 1, conceding twice in the last 20 minutes. [Sporting.pt](https://www.sporting.pt/en/news/football/main-team/2026-08-08/points-shared-matchday-1)
- 2026-08-02: Galatasaray drew 3-3 with Rennes in pre-season, and Buruk said the squad wasn't fully ready yet. [search snippet, Turkish press]
- Galatasaray reportedly have Rafael Leão, who came through Sporting's academy. This is unconfirmed before the cutoff.

## 4. Base rates
- Sporting are the reigning Portuguese champions and are hard to beat at Alvalade. In recent Champions League league phases they won most home games against mid-ranked opponents, but they have lost heavily to elite sides at home (for example 1-5 to Arsenal in 2024-25). I didn't fetch exact current figures.
- Galatasaray, in their recent Champions League campaigns, have been strong at home and weaker away.
- I couldn't confirm whether the two clubs have met competitively before.
- As a rough guide, home favourites in Champions League games between evenly matched teams win in regulation about 45-55% of the time, and about 20-25% of such games are draws. This is a general figure, not one checked for this fixture.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold price for this match from before 2026-08-31.
- I found no bookmaker odds or model forecasts published before the cutoff. Every preview and odds page I found was dated after 31 August.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Early September is a FIFA international window. Watch for injuries to Sporting's internationals (for example Catamo, Inácio and Maxi Araújo) and for how tired players are when they come back.
- The Liga Portugal and Süper Lig games around 29-30 August, plus any late transfer-window moves (the Portuguese and Turkish windows close in early September), could change either squad.
- The UEFA squad-list deadline and the injury and suspension news in the pre-match press conferences on 8 September are also worth watching.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

# Sporting CP vs Galatasaray, Champions League, 9 September 2026: research brief (to 31 Aug 2026)

## 1. Resolution source
- The primary source is UEFA's official match result, with Flashscore and then Sofascore as fallbacks. Only the 90 minutes plus stoppage time count, so a draw resolves "No". The UEFA fixture pages would not load through the proxy (connection refused), so I could not check them directly.
- UEFA's draw coverage gives matchday 1 as 8 to 10 September 2026. [UEFA](https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/02a8-2174c9e9019d-f909a77bd77a-1000--2026-27-champions-league-all-the-league-phase/)

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-08-31 the match has not been played, and nothing so far settles the question.
- It will be the first competitive meeting between the two clubs. [Observador](https://observador.pt/prognosticos/onde-assistir-sporting-galatasaray-09-09/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- Undated, pre-match: previews say Galatasaray's Victor Osimhen and Mario Lemina were injured in a league match against İstanbul Başakşehir. One source says both will miss the game; another says Osimhen will probably be absent. I could not confirm the date or the expected recovery times. [Fanatik](https://www.fanatik.com.tr/en/osimhen-is-injured-galatasarays-striker-was-unable-to-continue-in-the-match-against-basaksehir-2636723), [Ground News](https://ground.news/article/okan-buruk-we-lost-both-osimhen-and-lemina)
- Late August: Sporting were scheduled to host FC Alverca around 23 August and play Rio Ave around 28 to 30 August. Sources disagree on the dates, and I could not find either result. [zerozero](https://www.zerozero.pt/competicao/liga-portuguesa), [A Bola](https://www.abola.pt/noticias/eis-os-calendarios-completos-da-liga-e-da-liga-2-para-202627-2026070218520723632)
- 2026-08-14: Sporting beat Vitória SC 3-2 at home. They led 3-0 at half-time (Flávio Gonçalves, Ioannidis, Altimira) and conceded twice late. Only one source covers this. [Football Web Pages](https://www.footballwebpages.co.uk/match/2026-2027/portuguese-primeira-liga/sporting-cp/vitoria-guimaraes/587091)
- 2026-08-08: Sporting drew 2-2 away at Estrela da Amadora. Zalazar and Ioannidis scored, and Sporting conceded twice in the last 20 minutes. [Sporting CP](https://www.sporting.pt/en/news/football/main-team/2026-08-08/points-shared-matchday-1)
- 2026-08-07: coach Rui Borges begins his third season, with a contract running to 2028. [beIN Sports](https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/primeira-liga/articles/can-sporting-cp-win-liga-portugal-2026-08-07?mw=ki), [Sporting CP](https://www.sporting.pt/en/news/football/main-team/2026-08-07/borges-our-level-of-demand-has-be-its-fullest)
- Context: previews say Sporting reached the Champions League quarter-finals last season and Galatasaray come in as Turkish champions. [Observador](https://observador.pt/prognosticos/onde-assistir-sporting-galatasaray-09-09/)
- Sporting's form so far is mixed: they have conceded late goals in both confirmed league games.

## 4. Base rates
- In Champions League group and league-phase football, home teams win roughly 45 to 50% of matches. Draws are about 22 to 25%. This is general knowledge, not from a fetched source.
- When a strong home favourite at about 1.70 to 1.85 decimal odds is playing, the implied win probability is about 52 to 57%.
- I could not find a sourced tally of Sporting's recent home Champions League record.
- This is a first meeting, so there is no head-to-head history.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket and Kalshi both list markets on this game ("ucl-spo-gal-2026-09-09"). [Prediction Hunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/odds/ucl/galatasaray-vs-sporting-cp-2026-09-09/37375), [Polymarket team page](https://polymarket.com/bn/teams/ucl/galatasaray-sk)
- I could not find a price snapshot dated on or before 2026-08-31. The prices I did see were dated in September, after the cutoff, so I have left them out.
- Brazilian betting previews put Sporting as clear home favourites, at roughly 1.75 for a home win against 4.00 to 4.33 for Galatasaray. These pages are undated and may be from after the cutoff, so treat them with care. [Trivela](https://trivela.com.br/apostas/palpites-de-futebol/sporting-x-galatasaray-09-09-2026/), [NetVasco](https://www.netvasco.com.br/apostas/palpites/sporting-lisboa-x-galatasaray-palpites-odds-e-apostas-champions-league-09-09-2026/)
- I found no Manifold market or expert model forecast.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Early September (international window): national-team call-ups could bring injuries or fatigue for both squads. I could not confirm the window's exact dates.
- Galatasaray's injury updates on Osimhen and Lemina: their availability is the main swing factor in the team news.
- Sporting's last league game before the match and any squad news. The Champions League ticket sale was announced by Record. [Record](https://www.record.pt/futebol/futebol-nacional/liga-betclic/sporting/detalhe/sporting-define-criterios-para-os-bilhetes-da-champions-venda-comeca-quarta-feira)
- Confirmed line-ups, about one hour before kick-off on 2026-09-09.

Some search results returned pages dated after 2026-08-31. I ignored them as instructed.
